name: Financial Incentive to SC Meritorious Girls Students
benefit: A financial incentive of ₹5,000/- is provided.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be currently enrolled as a student. - The applicant must be female. - The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste (SC) community of Assam. - The applicant must have secured a minimum of 80% marks in the HSLC examination held in 2025. - The annual income of the applicant's parents/guardians must not exceed ₹5,00,000/-.
